name: What should I prepare before requesting a bathroom remodeling estimate?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before requesting a bathroom remodeling estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a contractor, determine your target budget, gather design inspiration, and list must-have features versus nice-to-have upgrades. Measure the room's rough dimensions and note any persistent functional problems, such as poor ventilation, persistent leaks, or inadequate storage. It is also helpful to check whether anyone in the household requires accessibility enhancements, such as curbless shower entries or grab-bar blocking. Having your material preferences and priorities documented helps the remodeling team provide an accurate initial estimate and realistic timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Establish your budget, list must-have upgrades, note existing plumbing or ventilation issues, and gather design ideas so your contractor can provide an accurate estimate.
